messages:
incident-bot: Paging: P0 - inference-serving high error rate in us-west-2. Trigger: 5xx spike > 20% for 3m. Paging oncall: @Devon (oncall)
Devon (oncall): got the page, joining. I’m seeing 502s from the edge -> backend error. Pulling logs now.
Aisha Khan: @Devon can you confirm customer-facing impact? Any major customers affected?
Devon (oncall): initial check: most traffic is degraded; about 18% CPU on backend instances at 80%+ and an application-level NPE in request handler for batch merging. 3 customers reported elevated 4xx/5xx in last 10m via support.
Ben Ortiz: linking recent deploy? I saw a canary earlier at 10:03. Deploy bot shows rollout to 40% at 10:05.
Devon (oncall): yeah investigating a correlation with the 10:05 rollout. Rolling back the canary now.
incident-bot: Deploy rollback initiated for release 2026.03.15-canary by @Devon.
Carla Mendez: mitigation note: flipped batch-merge flag to legacy mode, reduced error rate from dashboards. Keep us posted. :thumbsup:
Devon (oncall): rollback + flag toggle reduced 5xx to ~2% in 6m. Still trimming queues. Customer impact window estimate: 10:05 - 10:12 PT for major error spike, with residual latency until 10:18.
Aisha Khan: thanks. I’ll file a postmortem. Who wants to volunteer to draft the RCA? Needs timeline, contributing factors, impact summary, action items.
Elena Li: I can take first pass on timeline and root-cause analysis. Will start a draft doc.
Ben Ortiz: I’ll pair with Elena on mitigation / runbook gaps. I can pull deploy traces and autoscaler logs.
Carla Mendez: I’ll own customer-impact section and compile support tickets/CS notes.
OpsManager: assignable actions: new deploy gating checks, add preflight for batch merge toggles, runbook update for rollback + toggle.
Aisha Khan: scheduling: we should have a 30m postmortem sync today at 16:00 PT to review the draft before peer review. @Elena can you post a calendar invite and link to the doc?
Elena Li: will do. Draft link: https://docs.internal/redwood/pmr/1976543210 (working doc) — I'll populate timeline and attach logs.
Devon (oncall): copied a quick timeline here for the draft (feel free to paste into doc):
```
10:02 - Canary deploy started to 10%
10:05 - Canary increased to 40%
10:06 - Cloud alarms triggered: 5xx spike >20%
10:07 - Oncall paged (incident-bot)
10:08 - Devon investigates; identifies NPE in batch-merge handler
10:09 - Flag toggle to legacy batch-merge initiated
10:10 - Rollback to previous release started
10:12 - Rollback complete; errors drop to baseline
```
Aisha Khan: good. Elena — assign owner for each action item in doc. We should include an ETA for runbook updates (2 weeks) and a short-term control to block canary ramp beyond 20% until preflight passes.
Ben Ortiz: note: autoscaler removed some instances during the spike; adding a change request to prevent scale-down during deploy windows. I’ll draft the CR.
Carla Mendez: customer impact summary (short): three enterprise customers observed request failures during 10:05–10:12 PT; support routes: escalation to EMs, credits offered pending legal signoff. Will list ticket ids in doc.
Aisha Khan: peer review: @OpsManager and @Ben please review the RCA draft after Elena posts. We want sign-off by EOD tomorrow. Legal & security to review any customer-facing language.
OpsManager: ack. I’ll review and check that action owners have realistic timelines.
incident-bot: Reminder: postmortem draft due in 24 hours — please update the working doc.
Elena Li: draft uploaded and shared. Comments welcome. I added a section 'contributing factors' — deploy gating missing, insufficient canary validation for batch features, and a subtle race in batch-merge path under partial failure.
Ben Ortiz: left inline comments on the traces section and added a suggestion to include a preflight smoke test that hits the batch code path.
Devon (oncall): +1 on preflight. Also recommending alert tuning: separate 5xx by service to localize failures faster.
Carla Mendez: updated customer impacts with ticket numbers. Added recommended wording for customer communication; tagged legal.
Aisha Khan: next steps: 1) finalize RCA draft, 2) peer review complete, 3) create action items in Jira with owners & due dates, 4) schedule follow-up check in 2 weeks to verify actions.
Ben Ortiz: I’ll create the Jira epic and link individual tasks. ETA: by EOD.
OpsManager: once Jira tasks exist, I’ll own tracking and ensure closure.
Elena Li: request reviewers to give comments by 09:00 PT tomorrow. After that I’ll incorporate and mark ready for sign-off.
Aisha Khan: thanks team. Please add any follow-ups to the doc. I’ll post the final sign-off message here when complete.
Ben Ortiz: quick note: we should add a short blameless note about rollout process — framing for learning not blame.
Aisha Khan: agreed. Draft includes 'lessons learned' and 'preventative measures' sections.
Elena Li: marking draft as ready for review now.
incident-bot: Thread archived for notification purposes when sign-off posted.
Aisha Khan: sign-off pending reviewers — tag me when you approve. Once legal OKs customer note, I'll approve and we can close the summary and publish to incident board.
